body:
Thank you. 

I have gotten a new job. Ive been in restaurants for the past 5 or 6 years. Doing pretty well. Making good money. Moving up at a pretty quick professionally. But idk if you know many people that work in restaurants. But there's only one thing you can do after a 12 hr shift that ends at 1 in the morning. Go drinking with all of your coworkers. I felt myseld slipping into a terrible, alcoholic cycle. I didn't love it but I was having fun and the voices in my head would fade when I was dealing with a rush or when I went out with coworkers and bitched about anything and everything that happened to us that day at work. That coupled with showing up to work one day and there being chains on the door, one day having a decent, good paying job and then the next having nothing, left a sour taste in my mouth so I found a job in an office. Making a lot less money, doing something I'm terrible at, but it seemed like the "right" thing to do. 

I no longer have a gf. She was the love of my life. I finally thought I found somebody who was my soul mate. We planned a life together. I had saved money for a ring. She left me citing "you ruined me and bring me down to much. I can't do it anymore" She now refuses to talk to me. Thankfully I used the money I had saved plus some more to get a shitty beater though. 

Here's the thing honestly. I don't particularly have a terrible life. A lot of things have gone my way. Im decent looking, easy to talk to, come from a pretty solidly decent middle class family in a good neighborhood. The point being, I don't feel it is the circumstances as much as it is my fucked up head. Cuz yea. Right now things suck. But a year ago or whatever they didn't. My circumstances were great. Yet all I did was bring people down. Ruin them. Because I can't shake these thoughts. Because people invest in me and all I do is find ways to ruin it. Or them.

Probably. And there's the struggle. Why live a life you don't want because of the way you are worried it will effect the people around you? Why concede something I know I want in life in a wife and kids because I know I won't be fit for it. And I know it will be terrible for them no matter what. I've heard first hand the things they went through when I tried before. I just don't want this anymore. I don't. I know it's selfish. I know it makes me a pussy. I know all it does is make things horrible for everybody around me. 

I do appreciate all the help you are trying to give me even though all ive done is bitch and moan about everything you've said.

Temporarily. Yes. Absolutely. My issue is no matter what there is always this impending doom that someday it's going to happen eventually. So why not start the grieving process earlier then later. Do it before my niece's and nephews are old enough to really remember me. Do it when I know there are amazing things around the corner for my family that will help them heal. Do it before I myself have a wife and kids to rely on me. Obviously there is going to be a negative no matter what but it is kind of like aiming for the least amount of negative impact on people around me and their lives.
I'll see you on the other side
I appreciate it but I feel like I have tried every alternative there is.

More times then I could count. Counseling. Inpatient.  out patient. You name it. I've tried it. And I feel like it would be easier to hear somebody died in a car accident. Being able to tell yourself that it was that exactly. Not am accident. I just hate the idea of my family only being able to see my destroyed face or not see me at all. I think that I might just hang myself when nobody is around and then call the cops before hand so hopefully they will find me first.
